title: Patient Financial Services Manual — Application of Patient Payments and Accepted Methods
content:
**4.1 Clauses no longer in force.** The following clauses of this Patient Financial Account policy are no longer in force and have been superseded by the current basis:

- (a) the clause applying a payment to open charges in the tier's allocation order (oldest date of service first, and among charges of the same date the earlier posting first), one allocation per charge, each allocation never exceeding that charge's remaining balance;
- (b) the clause applying a payment to a specific encounter only when the patient names that encounter's encounter number;
- (c) the clause charging the post-adjudication balance of an encounter on the High-Deductible Health Plan Account to the card on file up to the class's maximum automatic charge, only once the class's advance-notice days had passed since the charge was posted, with any excess over that cap statemented normally.

The per-class figures these clauses named remain the figures of the financial classes.

**4.2 Overpayment.** Any part of a payment exceeding everything owed stays on the account as a credit balance, handled under the credit balance rules of the Patient Financial Account.

**4.3 Accepted methods.** Card, HSA/FSA card (where the class accepts HSA/FSA cards), cash at the front desk, card on file, check and ACH are accepted, except that check and ACH are refused while the account's count of returned payments is at or above the tier's number of returned payments before restriction. The count of returned payments is the number of payment reversals on the account whose method was check or ACH and whose date falls inside the rolling window of the tier's look-back months ending on the handling date; the window reaches back that many calendar months to the same day of the month, or to the month's last day where that day does not exist in the earlier month.

| Returned check/ACH payments in the look-back, against the tier's restriction count | Card, HSA/FSA card, cash, card on file | Check and ACH |
|---|---|---|
| below the count | accepted | accepted |
| at or above the count | accepted | refused |

**4.4 Payment-plan installments.** Payment-plan installments are applied to the charges enrolled in that plan, oldest first.

**Hypothetical illustration.** On a class with a restriction count of 2 and a 12-month look-back, an account with one returned ACH payment inside the look-back may still pay by check; after a second returned check inside the same look-back, check and ACH are refused and card or cash is taken.

superseded_clauses: A payment is applied to open charges in the tier's payment_allocation_order (oldest date of service first, and among charges of the same date the lower txn_date first), one allocation per charge, each allocation never exceeding that charge's remaining balance.
A payment is applied to a specific encounter only when the patient names that encounter's encounter number.

On the High-Deductible Health Plan Account, where card_on_file_required is true, the post-adjudication balance of an encounter is charged to the card on file up to card_on_file_max_auto_charge_usd, and only once card_on_file_notice_days have passed since the charge was posted; any excess over that cap is statemented normally.
